commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply conventions and create commits as needed.

options.name: --open-pr
options.description: Apply conventions, create commits, and open or update a pull request. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-merge
options.description: Enable auto-merge for the generated pull request. [default: False]

options.name: --no-auto-merge
options.description: Disable auto-merge for this run even if configuration enables it. [default: False]

options.name: --merge-method
options.description: Preferred merge method for the generated pull request: merge, squash, or rebase.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a convention path to the configuration file.
